record: PWB shared amendment engine: all-orders composition check, rule-6 mutation run
method: Each mutant rewrites exactly one fragment (asserted to occur once) of the subject in a scratch clone at the commit, runs --selftest of both builders that import the engine (scripts/build_pwb_opening_index_amendment.py, scripts/build_pwb_accessible_name_amendment.py), and restores the file byte-for-byte. A mutant is killed when both runs exit nonzero and print the expected SELFTEST FAILED line for its own predicate.
soundness: git apply is a function of its input bytes, so two application orders that reach the same spec bytes with the same patches remaining share every outcome; memoizing on (bytes, remaining set) therefore covers all n! orders exactly. Each step removes one patch, so a key is never re-entered before it is memoized and first visits count distinct states.
